description: This Java source file defines a helper class for unit tests involving the Eclipse Hono client. It provides static methods to create mocked objects such as Vertx Context, ProtonSender, ProtonReceiver, SpanBuilder, and HonoConnection, which are used to facilitate unit testing by mocking dependencies.

classes.name: HonoClientUnitTestHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for creating mocked objects for unit testing the Hono client.

methods.name: mockContext
methods.description: Creates a mocked Vertx Context that immediately executes handlers passed to runOnContext.

methods.name: mockProtonSender
methods.description: Creates a mocked ProtonSender that is always open and has a specific QoS.

methods.name: mockProtonReceiver
methods.description: Creates a mocked ProtonReceiver that is always open.

methods.name: mockSpanBuilder
methods.description: Creates a mocked SpanBuilder configured to produce a specified Span during start().

methods.name: mockHonoConnection
methods.description: Creates a mocked HonoConnection that returns a Noop Tracer, with overloads accepting Vertx and optional client properties.
